status: Declared before fitting new models or inspecting their ranking orders. Local research only; existing three models and frozen prospective blend remain unchanged.
objective: Assess whether independently reconstructed recorded-stat features improve future FBS-FBS win probabilities over the existing Predictive Strength baseline.

originalityPolicy.recordedFacts: Use verified scores, participants, venue, dates, subdivisions and recorded team box-score counts. Reuse stable identities and standard statistical definitions; originality means our documented computations and fitted model, not inventing a new definition for every familiar statistic.
originalityPolicy.derivedAllowed: A deterministic rate may be reconstructed from audited recorded numerators and denominators. Retaining a provider-derived value requires a matching declared definition, population and timing audit; agreement of current rankings alone is insufficient.
excluded: provider successRate in this new candidate
originalityPolicy.existingPerformance: The current Performance model uses provider success rates over PPA-eligible plays, not PPA numerical values. That source-population dependency is disclosed and is not silently relabeled as an independently rebuilt all-play statistic.
originalityPolicy.missing: Missing raw records and zero-opportunity rates stay unavailable. Unit parameters shrink toward declared neutral priors with explicit observed counts; no fictitious raw games are inserted.
originalityPolicy.unavailable: Raw plays are required before reconstructing play success/explosiveness, drive measures, overtime/garbage-time filters. Player attribution and special teams require separately audited fields. Do not fabricate these from aggregate boxes.

data.source: Existing checksum-pinned ESPN recorded team box counts distributed by SportsDataverse, linked by exact game/team IDs to repaired CFBD outcome histories. These are not represented as CFBD-derived model statistics.

excludedYears.2020: Disrupted season and prior source caveats
excludedYears.2021-2022: Raw box files not in this already authorized cache; do not fetch to fill the gap during this experiment
excludedYears.2026: Current illustration is not a trustworthy timestamped weekly raw-stat replay and cannot select the model

data.coverage: Preserve every completed parent target game, even without target-game statistics. Fit unit features only from paired verified FBS/FCS source games. Report every missing field/game and counts by team/year/subdivision; retain native baseline coverage separately.
data.time: Before earliest kickoff of each complete parent competition week; only earlier processed weeks with kickoff+24hours<=cutoff. No target-week result or statistic enters the input graph. Corrected retrospective sources do not prove contemporaneous availability.

definitions.ypp: Recorded totalYards / (recorded passing attempts + recorded rushing attempts)
definitions.passingYpp: Recorded netPassingYards / recorded pass attempts; not claimed as true dropback efficiency without separate sack-denominator verification
definitions.rushingYpp: Recorded rushingYards / recorded rushingAttempts; includes the source's college sack-accounting convention
definitions.thirdDownRate: Recorded successful third downs / recorded third-down attempts
definitions.fourthDownRate: Recorded successful fourth downs / recorded fourth-down attempts; zero attempts is unavailable
definitions.turnoverRate: Recorded turnovers lost / (passing attempts + rushing attempts); do not add interceptions and fumbles a second time
definitions.penaltyYardsPerPlay: Recorded total penalty yards / (passing attempts + rushing attempts); includes all team penalties, not claimed as offense-only attribution

features.unitModel: Separate regularized offense and defensive allowance effects for each metric: value=intercept+offenseEffect+allowanceEffect+H*offenseVenue+D*(offenseFbs-defenseFbs). Individual opponents retained; no conference or team-name term. Defense observations are opponent offensive counts.
features.prior: No previous team effects in raw-unit fits. The Strength feature deliberately retains the existing model's own earlier-season strength prior.
features.matchup: Each metric supplies predicted home production minus predicted away production using only preweek fitted units and fixture venue. Also retain metric observation counts. No duplicate manual statistical bonuses.
features.primaryEligibility: Both teams have>=4 completed outcome games and>=4 measured basic ypp games. Other sparse metric units use their explicitly declared shrunken estimates and retain support counts. Both compared models use identical eligible targets.

prediction.mapping: Ridge-penalized logistic regression, no intercept; venue is0neutral/1home. Scale difference features by training-only RMS without centering, preserving neutral matchup orientation symmetry. Zero-scale features get scale1. No arbitrary percentage blend of statistics.
prediction.selection: Fit scaling/weights on2014-2017, select unit ridge and logistic penalty by pooled2018-2019 log loss. Tie within1e-10 prefers stronger logistic penalty then stronger unit ridge; families break ties by fewer input features then declared order. Select a best broader candidate among non-strength families separately from the Strength control. Never use2023-2025 for selection.
prediction.refit: After older-only selection, refit selected family weights/scales on2014-2019. This remains strictly earlier than evaluation seasons. No further grid expansion or evaluation-driven coefficient changes.

evaluation.target: Confirmed completed FBS-FBS parent games; target eligibility is independent of whether its future box score downloaded.
evaluation.primary: Compare selected broader candidate and calibrated Strength on identical established target games. Report win accuracy, Brier, log loss, probability bias, yearly metrics and regular/postseason/venue groups.
evaluation.nativeBaseline: Report Strength on all parent games with both teams>=4 prior outcome games as a separate coverage diagnostic; do not compare unmatched samples as an accuracy advantage.
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 paired complete season-type-week-block resamples within year, seed1729, for candidate-minus-baseline Brier/logloss/accuracy. Shared teams connect weeks; intervals are sensitivity summaries, not calibrated prospective significance.
evaluation.diagnostics: Report all fixed family results as diagnostics, selected older configurations, learned coefficients, missingness and consequential game disagreements. No ranking-order-based tuning.
evaluation.limits: Source seasons, outcomes and some prior statistics were already inspected. These are repeated retrospective results even with new features, not an untouched test. A new model needs a separately versioned future trial before a public replacement.

operations.storage: Use existing private cached raw sources; save only derived reports and source hashes for review. No raw/API data or credentials published.
operations.production: Hash existing src/frontend/published/configuration and both frozen blend capture/evaluation bindings before/after. No edits to live rankings, schedules, frozen protocols or observations.
operations.promotion: Research only. A failed or inferior candidate remains reported; do not replace the current model just because more fields were used.
